tagline.en: UK MNO — premium coverage; cheap PAYG eSIM exists only via CS chat
tagline.zh: 英国实体运营商——覆盖顶级，便宜Paygo eSIM只在客服渠道

description.en: Vodafone UK is a full MNO with its own network (merged with Three UK). Storefront eSIM plans are expensive; the affordable options — a £10 Pay-as-you-go eSIM and a basic monthly plan — are offered only through customer service, per the 2026-03 review. Keep-alive: 90+90 structure — after 90 days without top-up or usage a warning text is sent, and the number is disconnected only after a further 90 days without use (net 180 days). No real-name ID required; strong EU roaming coverage.
description.zh: Vodafone英国是拥有自有网络的实体运营商（已与Three合并）。官网在售eSIM套餐偏贵；据2026-03盘点，划算的选项——10英镑Paygo eSIM与基础月付——仅客服渠道提供。保号：90+90结构——90天无充值或使用先发提醒短信，再90天仍无使用才断号（净效果180天）。无需实名认证，欧盟漫游覆盖较好。

details.en:
Vodafone UK is the premium tier of this UK roundup: own-network coverage (and post-merger scale with Three), good EU roaming, no real-name ID — but you pay for it unless you haggle. The storefront's eSIM plans run expensive; repeated CS chats in the source review confirmed the cheapest routes are a £10 Pay-as-you-go eSIM and a basic monthly plan, both CS-only, with nothing cheaper available. Free-trial eSIM promos (a 7-day trial announced in May, an expanded free-join pilot in June 2026) were dead on arrival when attempted at review time, but 7-day trials were still being promoted at 2026 festivals — availability is intermittent and event-based.

Keep-alive is a 90+90 structure: 90 days without top-up or usage triggers a warning text, and the number is disconnected only after a further 90 days without use (other official pages summarise it as "use it once every 180 days"). Best for high-budget users who need top-tier network stability; cloud residents roaming mainly in China get better value from giffgaff, CTExcel or CMLink.
details.zh:
Vodafone 英国是本轮英国盘点的「高配档」：自有网络覆盖（与 Three 合并后规模更大）、欧盟漫游条件好、下单无需实名——但对应的代价是不还价就要多花钱。

官网在售的 eSIM 套餐普遍偏贵；源盘点中多轮客服对话确认，最便宜的路径是 10 英镑的 Pay as you go eSIM 与基础月付套餐，两者都只能通过人工客服办理，且再无更低价格。免费试用 eSIM 的促销——2026 年 5 月宣布的 7 天试用、6 月扩大的免费加入试点——盘点时实测失效，但 2026 年音乐节季仍在推广 7 天试用，可用性随活动间歇波动，不要按旧攻略抱期望。

保号是 90+90 结构：90 天无充值或使用先触发提醒短信，再 90 天仍无使用才断号（官方另一页面概括为「每 180 天使用一次」）。适合预算充足、要顶级网络稳定的用户；以中国漫游为主的云居民，giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink 的性价比明显更高。

bestFor.en: High-budget users who prioritise network stability and EU roaming on a full MNO.
bestFor.zh: 预算充足、最看重实体运营商网络稳定性与欧盟漫游的用户。

note.en: A motorhome forum thread reports a dealer-verified case: Vodafone UK SIMs roaming in Portugal kept a UK IP and streamed iPlayer fine, matching what multiple customers reported. Consistent with UK MNO home-routing practice; no official Vodafone doc on exit IP.
note.zh: 房车论坛帖子（经销商验证）称 Vodafone UK 卡在葡萄牙漫游保持英国 IP、iPlayer 正常，多个客户反馈一致；符合英国运营商母网回程惯例，但官方无出口 IP 文档。
